scope: Read-only UE5.8 primary local source and root actual owner-writeback result; no engine call by reviewer.
failure_cause: get_editor_property returns the array by reference, but array indexing returns source model copies. Changing a nested reduction on that copy alone does not update the owning mesh.
required_path: Keep the original returned unreal.Array. Modify a retrieved model, set reduction back into model, assign model back into that same array element, then notify the owner and explicitly read back before regeneration.
preservation_reason: SourceModel WithCopy=false falls back to reflected field-by-field CopyScriptStruct into the existing array element. Existing destination non-reflected raw/cache members are left intact. With the original owner reference, the final owner setter sees the same array and skips wholesale replacement.
limits: This is not a safety claim for Python list conversion, array.copy, fresh SourceModel construction, or replacement of the whole source array. Full array copying empties/reinitializes destination entries and can lose non-reflected state.
The source rationale is corroborated by actual root regeneration/readback/persistence and LOD0/skeleton/guide guards, not a reviewer runtime execution.

primary_source.fact: Editor getter Pythonizes property by Reference.
Indexed getter uses default conversion; setter writes into existing raw element pointer.
Struct copyback into destination and identical-value test before array replacement.
Non-native struct copy falls back to reflected field copying.
Actual full array copy empties/reinitializes non-POD elements.
SourceModel inherits LODInfo, is noncopyable natively/WithCopy=false, has reflected bulkdata UObject and non-reflected caches.
